Ambrosia Jello Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 11, 2009 - 12:45am

Ingredients




Pistachio instant pudding (sm.)
1 can drained pineapple chunks (may use fruit cocktai
Large Cool Whip
1/2 bag mini marshmallows
1 cup coconut, optional

Preparation

1 Whip together dry pudding and container of Cool Whip and fold in pineapple and marshmallows. Add coconut, optional. Keep refrigerated.
